_purpose: Tasks whose completion cannot be derived from the repository, declared complete by a human.
_why: 20 of the 61 tasks are sessions with Emily, trustee demos, DocuSign template work or tests against a live environment. No repository evidence can ever prove them, so derive-wbs-state.py reports them as manual_only and they would block every dependent task forever. A declaration here is the same instrument as the V4 open-and-save step in agents/pipeline-agent.md: a named person asserting something a tool cannot observe.
_rules: Every entry needs declared_by, declared_on and one line of what happened.
A declaration is not evidence of quality — it records that the activity occurred.
Never declare a task whose evidence IS derivable. Fix the evidence rule instead.
